sources.content:
Today, I rise to support our veterans and the brave men and women who have served this country. And I rise to say hell no to the privatization of the VA! ✊🇺🇸

👏👏👏

The profit motive is HORRENDOUS at public services required for a stable productive society:
healthcare
the military
public safety (police, fire, EMS, etc.)
education
human incarceration
utilities
research
all regulations

republicans are 100% wrong on privatization.

whenever an organization is privatized, it's only the CEO, CFO, and FCO who profit. and it's just a matter of time before the companies that go private go bankrupt and nobody ever seems to know where the money went while those in charge get a golden parachute!!!!

Why are you allowing your people to attempt to discredit this journalists findings?  www.facebook.com/authoralisav...

Thank you for standing up for us Veterans!

Conclusion Problems posed by alarm technologies, alongside the enormous growth of a private security industry , offer public police another opportunity to reeval-uate the services they now provide. explanation.text: Rep. Melanie Stansbury expressed strong opposition to the privatization of the Veterans Affairs (VA) system, stating that it negatively impacts veterans and public services.
Stansbury’s post emphasizes support for veterans and argues against the privatization of public services like healthcare, military, and utilities.

Privatization of public services has historically led to inefficiencies and inequalities, as referenced in MIT's study on its effects, supporting concerns about privatization's impact on essential services.
